INDIAMERE JULIETTMERE NOVEMBERTON JR

Incident page for this loss

Name: BG Juliettmere Novemberton Indiamere, Jr. (posthumously promoted)
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: 18 ENG BDE
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 05/12/1970; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Army; regular component; UU branch
Country: South Vietnam
Aircraft: UH-1H tail number 68-16342
Short Summary: Shot down by .51 cal fire 10 miles SE of Pleiku while flying a general on an aerial tour.
